activity.label: Team activity
activity.help: Track what the team does during working hours.

scorecard.label: Weekly scorecard
scorecard.help: The weekly scorecard of each person.

credits.label: Credits and leaderboard
credits.help: Who gets credit for results; the leaderboard.

credit_extras.label: Extra credits
credit_extras.help: Extra credits on top of the normal ones.

web.label: Website access
web.help: Who may use the website (admins always can).

files.label: Files
files.help: Files on or off, and who sees everyone's files.

upload_rules.label: Upload rules
upload_rules.help: Rules for uploaded papers (edited on the web).

fees.label: Fees and payments
fees.help: Fees, payment methods, receipt design, reminders.

assignment.label: Assignment
assignment.help: How new $t(labels:lead.plural) are given to people (e.g. round robin).

lead_cards.label: $t(labels:lead.singular) cards
lead_cards.help: What a card in the list shows.

speed_to_lead_minutes.label: First call within (minutes)
speed_to_lead_minutes.help: A new $t(labels:lead.singular) not called within this time is escalated.

escalate_team_lead_hours.label: Escalate to the team lead after (hours)
escalate_team_lead_hours.help: When the team lead is told.

call_lock.label: Call lock
call_lock.help: Only one person calls a $t(labels:lead.singular) at a time.

double_call.label: Double-call warning
double_call.help: Warn before calling someone just called.

contacts_import.label: Phone contacts
contacts_import.help: Who may use the phone's contacts.

ai_providers.label: AI provider and budget
ai_providers.help: Provider, model and monthly budget (keys stay in the vault).

quiet_hours.label: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.help: No messages or reminders in these hours.

scorecard_day.label: Scorecard day
scorecard_day.help: Day the weekly scorecard is made.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: Currency and how amounts are written.

default_language.label: Default language
default_language.help: Language for people who have not chosen one.

bangla_digits.label: Bangla digits
bangla_digits.help: Where numbers are written with Bangla digits.

developer_email.label: Feedback inbox
developer_email.help: Who receives feedback and error reports.

purge_notice_days.label: Days before a closed institution's data is deleted
purge_notice_days.help: After an institution is closed, its data is kept this long (it can still be exported), then deleted. Proposed: 90.

trial_limit_per_person.label: Trial institutions per person or phone
trial_limit_per_person.help: More open trials than this from one person or phone are flagged in the approval queue. Proposed: 2.
